BrondbyTV.se.d: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.
Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Marko Divkovic om skiftet fra angreb til forsvar, Daniel Wass deler sine tanker om rollen som playmaker, og Jonathan Ægidius giver et indblik i konkurrencen og kampen om pladsen mellem stængerne.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du status fra Jesper Sørensen og spillerne Rasmussen, Kvistgaarden, Bischoff og Rajović. Hør deres refleksioner om sæsonen, præstationerne og hvad der venter forude i jagten på succes.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne deres bedste udebaneminder, yndlingsfilm og hvem der ville vinde Wimbledon – eller Vild med dans. Du får også svar på, hvem der er nemmest at forskrække og mest savnet i vinterpausen.

I denne episode af 'Vores Brøndby' dykker et nyt panel med Colding, Kahlenberg og Nanna Møller Karlsen ned i klubbens største kampe. Allan Ravn gæster studiet og fortæller om sit ikoniske mål mod Bayern München og de oplevelser, der har formet Brøndby.

I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' dyster spillerne i buzz-ball, fodboldgolf og straffesparkskonkurrence mellem Danmark og Norge. Der er også stil på programmet, og så kæmpes der om æren i “Tættest på midten".

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' besøger du spillernes hotel med Mileta Rajović, ser Jordi og Ohi vise rundt i Østrig, oplever Klaiber og Nartey i Portugal – og får et kig ind i villaerne sammen med Kvist og Kevin T.

BrondbyTV.se.st: Afsnit 1: Fraklip fra året der gik - #1-5
BrondbyTV.se.d: I 'Fraklip fra året der gik' får du de sjoveste øjeblikke fra Brøndby IF, der aldrig nåede skærmen. Grin med, når spillerne snubler i replikkerne, joker bag kulisserne og viser deres menneskelige side fra træningslejre, interviews og hverdagen.

I 'Vores Brøndby' får det faste hold besøg af Noah Nartey til en snak om livet som prof i dag vs. 90’erne. De vender krav, mediepres og træningskultur, før ung mod gammel klæder to giner i hjemme- og udebanesæt.

I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' skyder spillerne Black Friday-rabatter i No Bounce Challenge, mens Alves, Cappis og Maxsø dyster i tre intense udfordringer. Til sidst gælder det præcision og pres i en klassisk crossbar challenge.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Jordi Vanlerberghe om sit første derby, Frederik Birk giver et indblik i rollen som assistenttræner, og Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer en stor milepæl med sine første 100 kampe for Brøndby IF.

I 'Vores Brøndby' gæster Nikolaj Koppel og sætter ord på fankulturen: fællesskab, traditioner og hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget for så mange. Til sidst udfordres han til at spille “Jump” på et virkelig dårligt legetøjskeyboard.

BrondbyTV.se.st: Reportage - Se hele træningen fra 12. januar
BrondbyTV.se.d: Følg med, når Joel Kabongo tager mikrofonen og guider dig gennem en helt almindelig træning med Superliga-truppen en januareftermiddag. Få et unikt indblik i tempoet, stemningen og detaljerne, der præger hverdagen på træningsbanen.
Søren Colding sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' kommer du med spillerne ud og prøver kræfter med håndbold, ser deres reaktioner på ratings i det nye FIFA-spil og kommer helt med bag kulisserne til en derbysejr i Parken.

I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du unikt indblik gennem Mic’d Up med Jesper Sørensen i London, fysisk træner Anders Storskov og Frederik Birk. Kom helt tæt på stemningen, dialogen og detaljerne fra trænernes hverdag.

I denne episode af 'Vores Brøndby' ser panelet nærmere på livet uden for Superliga-holdet. Med Jacob Ambæk og Theresa Eslund sættes der fokus på Masterclass og kvindeholdet – og deres betydning for klubbens udvikling, identitet og fremtid.

I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' ser vi tilbage på året der gik i 2024 med masser af sjove øjeblikke, og spillerne tester hinanden i at gætte ratings i det nye EAFC 25. Grin, konkurrence og håneret er i centrum, når bolden ruller uden for banen.

I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Benjamin Tahirović og Sebastian Sebulonsen. Hør om Tahirović’ første tid i klubben, og hvordan det klikkede fra start – og få Sebulonsens egne refleksioner over hans sæson i Brøndby IF.

I første episode får Ibi Støving, Daniel Wass, Søren Colding og Dan Anton Johansen besøg af John “Faxe” Jensen til en snak om Brøndbys historie – og slutter med at sætte deres bedste Brøndby 5-a-side nogensinde.

I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' tager Mads Hermansen dig med ind i sejren over ærkerivalerne, Kevin Mensah sætter ord på sin rolle som leder, og Jacob Rasmussen deler sit syn på ansvar, struktur og rollen som forsvarsgeneral i Brøndby IF.

I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' ser vi tilbage på sæsonen med Nicolai Vallys og Mathias Greve. Hør deres egne ord om højdepunkter, udfordringer og oplevelserne i Brøndby IF-trøjen gennem en intens og mindeværdig Superliga-sæson.

Kom helt tæt på trænerteamet i 29 intense og fokuserede dage, når Superliga-truppen gøres klar til forårspremieren. Oplev forberedelserne, beslutningerne og pulsen bag kulisserne, hvor hver detalje tæller frem mod den første kamp.
Martin Retov sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som først bød på en årrække som spiller og siden som træner.
Mogens Krogh sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne, hvem der ville vinde Tour de France, hvem de ville stemme på som statsminister – og hvem der er bedst i et køkken. Du får også deres bud på yndlingsmusik, idoler og drømme uden for fodbolden.

I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du med bag kulisserne til opgøret i Viborg og sejrene i Aarhus og Silkeborg. Oplev intensiteten, stemningen og de afgørende øjeblikke, når Brøndby jagter point på tre svære udebaner i Superligaen.

I andet afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne fortsætter fortællingerne fra direktionsgangen på Vestegnen, hvor der reflekteres over store beslutninger, særlige øjeblikke og den evige tilknytning til Brøndby IF.

Yugi, Kaiba, and Tea are separated from the others as the Big 5 (minus Nesbitt) plan to take their bodies anyway. As Noah tortures Kaiba by brainwashing Mokuba, he reveals his true identity as Gozaboro Kaiba's biological son.
Noah gives the Big Five one last chance to redeem themselves in a five-on-two tag team duel where Yugi and Joey take on the entire Big Five, who are using Tristan's body.

The Big 5 attempt various strategies of victory, with the aim of eliminating Joey first. However, their poor teamwork soon puts Yugi and Joey ahead. Lector then calls their most powerful monster to the field, the Five Head Dragon.

90sKids.us.st: Arnold Betrays Iggy/Helga and the Nanny
90sKids.us.d: Arnold accidentally breaks a promise he made to Iggy and must deal with the consequences. / Big Bob hires a nanny for Helga. Helga fights the nanny at her own game and forces her to leave.

Arnold becomes a hot (and dangerous) hitter. He keeps injuring people every time he swings the bat. Afraid of hurting more people, Arnold refuses to play ball. / Arnold and Gerald manage the career of the unlikely country-and-western singer, Mr. Hyunh.
Arnold lends Sid his room for one evening, but the arrangement backfires when Sid keeps on borrowing the room. / Helga and Patty (the big girl) face off.

All the kids are paired with adults with interesting jobs except Arnold, who is forced to spend time with the Jolly Olly Man. / Harold believes it's his life's calling to become a butcher, but he slowly drives Mr. Greene, the butcher, crazy.

Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

90sKids.us.st: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War
90sKids.us.d: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War: Phoebe agrees to take a dive so that Helga can win a competition./The boys engage in a recreation of a historical battle, only this time their prized pig is in danger of losing his life.
Best Man/Cool Party: The Coach wants to remarry Tish and asks Arnold to be his best man./ Rhonda has a party and only invites the cool kids.
Sid''s Revenge/Roller Coaster: After Arnold accidentally embarrasses Sid, Sid seeks revenge./ Eugene wants to ride with the gang, but they all think he''s a jinx and won''t go with him.

Grandpa's Birthday/Road Trip: Grandpa thinks he's going to die soon because no one in his family ever made it past his age. He prepares to die, and Arnold tries to convince him that life is still worth living.

Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach.  Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense.  Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way.  She turns out to be Grandma.

Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends.  They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine.  She performs the new act, but it's boring.
Arnold and Helga perform a \"Romeo and Juliet\"- type play for a school production
At the Parent's Day competition, Arnold learns that even though he doesn't have \"real\" parents, his grandparents are just as good as everyone else's parents.

Eugene's Birthday: Arnold is the cause of two birthday party's for Eugene being a big flop.
Stinky's Pumpkin: Stinky feels that he is a failure at everything he does until Arnold helps him discover that he is the best pumpkin grower in town.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Dinner for Four/Phoebe Skips
90sKids.us.d:
Dinner for Four: After winning coupons to a fancy French restaurant, Helga attempts to prove to Arnold that she is more sophisticated than Lila. 
Phoebe Skips: Helga is devastated when her patsy, Phoebe, is skipped to the 6th grade.

Full moon: When the gang all decide that they are going to "moon" Principal Wartz, Arnold thinks that it's a bad idea, but ends up inadvertently getting caught and taking the blame.
Student Teacher: Olga comes to PS 118 to be a student teacher.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Big Gino/Jamie O in Luv
90sKids.us.d:
Big Gino: Sid gets in over his head when doing business with the local kid loan shark, Big Gino.
Jamie O in Luv: Gerald's big brother, Jamie O, falls for a girl and suddenly turns nice to his kid brother.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Beeper Queen/Oscar Can't Read?
90sKids.us.d:
Beeper Queen: Big Bob pulls his back and cannot go to a very important meeting. Not knowing who else to send in his place, he asks Helga.
Oscar Can't Read?: When Arnold discovers that Oskar has been pretending to know how to read, Arnold confronts him.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: The Headless Cabbie/Friday the 13th
90sKids.us.d:
The Headless Cabbie: Wolfgang dares Arnold and the gang to break superstitions, which causes a spate of bad luck to erupt.
Friday the 13th: At a sleepover, Arnold and the boys sit around and tell scary stories.

Helga's Parrot: Big Bob gets a pesky parrot he passes to Helga, who confides in it about Arnold.
Chocolate Turtles: Arnold and Gerald sell chocolate turtles to fund their go-cart project.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Love and Cheese/Weighing Harold
90sKids.us.d:
Love and Cheese: Arnold goes all out to win Lila's affection by taking her to the Annual Cheese Festival.
Weighing Harold: Harold feels that he has gotten too fat, so he gets his parents to send him on a weight-off cruise.

It Girl: Helga becomes the latest child fashion star and everyone loves her for her scowl and bad attitude.
Deconstructing Arnold: The gang finally gets sick of Arnold's never-ending good advice, so they all decide to stop listening to him all together.

Grudge Match: Arnold and Grandpa vs Helga and Big Bob in a fender bender blame game.
Polishing Rhonda: Rhonda and Patty's rivalry heats up at finishing school.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Back to School/Egg Story
90sKids.us.d:
Back To School: Grandpa returns to grade school so he can finally fulfill his dream of graduating.
Egg Story: Mr. Simmons gives the class an assignment to couple up and take care of an egg over the weekend to learn teamwork and responsibility.

Weird Cousin: Arnold's weird cousin, Arnie, arrives for a visit and appears to be the biggest loser to everyone except Lila, the love of Arnold's life.
Baby Oskar: Oskar's wife Susie agrees to watch her cousin's baby, also named Oskar.

Helga Sleepwalks: Helga begins to sleepwalk and ends up walking to Arnold's house. 
Fighting Families: The Fighting Families Contest has come to town and have selected two families: one from PS 118 and PS 119.

Monkeyman!: Arnold is saved from thugs by a mysterious, caped character named Monkeyman.
Buses, Bikes, Subways: Out on a field trip, Harold and Helga miss the bus and get separated from the rest of the class.

Grandpa's sister: Mitzi arrives unexpectedly at the boarding house.
Synchronized Swimming: Coach Wittenberg recruits Arnold's gang for a synchronized swim team.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga's Masquerade/Mr. Green Runs
90sKids.us.d:
Helga's Masquerade: When Helga realizes that Arnold is so taken by Lila because of her wit and charm, she decides that the only way to get Arnold to notice her is to be like Lila.
Mr. Green Runs: Arnold helps Mr. Green run for the City Council.

90sKids.us.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga On The Couch
90sKids.us.d: Helga is recommended for counseling after Mr. Simmons observes her berating Arnold, arguing with her parents, etc. She learns that unrequited love is very normal and that she's actually okay.

Washed up balladeer Dino Spumoni fakes his own death in order to increase his record sales.  Everyone believes he's dead and at the funeral, Grandpa and Arnold find out that Dino has left Arnold all his future record sales.
By complete coincidence, Arnold and Helga and family end up at the same beach resort for summer vacation. Helga is ecstatic until Arnold meets Summer, the girl of his dreams.
After a chilling vampire movie, Sid is so spooked that he believes that Stinky has all of the characteristics of a vampire. Olga comes home and wants to be a big sister to a little girl.

90sKidsTV2.us.d: The Palm Woods school is having it's annual Prom and Carlos, James, Logan and Kendall are all determined to win the prom king title, doing whatever it takes to win.
A teen magazine runs a “Win a Date with BTR” contest, and the 4 lucky winning girls – each with their own baggage – give the guys serious dating drama.

Lucy, an 18-year-old rocker chick moves into the Palm Woods and she immediately blows the BTR guys away by how cool she is. Carlos and James are desperate to date Lucy, while Kendall tries to prove that BTR can rock too.
BTR refuses to record their second album after Gustavo is too hard on them, and the strike pits the determined band against their stubborn producer in a battle of wills.
While Gustavo struggles to write the band's next hit song, the guys try to cheer up Kendall, who is heartbroken after his break-up with Jo.
Hawk has returned and has a new evil plan to take down Big Time Rush. He plans on stealing BTR's new tracks for their second album and releasing them himself.

Secrets are being kept at the Palm Woods. Kendall and Camille are spending a lot of time together making Logan suspicious. James reveals he never told Carlos that Heather Fox, Carlos' camp crush, liked him.

The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.

BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.

Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.

Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.
Kendall and Lucy are about to have their first kiss when her good looking ex-boyfriend Beau shows up to win her back. Griffin recruits Logan and Carlos to help him prepare for corporate espionage.
Kendall is ready to ask out Lucy, but Jo unexpectedly shows up and Kendall has to decide which girl is the one for him. Meanwhile Carlos and James’ friendship is put to the test.

Kendall and Logan must take care of Rocque Records' newest artist – an out-of-it rock legend until his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame that night. James and Carlos are stuck babysitting Katie.

The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.

Kendall and Logan volunteer at a dog shelter and end up adopting 12 dogs, but a sneaky heath inspector is on to them. Carlos and Jennifer’s puppy love is sickening and it’s up to James and the other Jennifers to rescue them.

Kendall buys Jo a gold necklace to show that he’s committed, but Camille thinks Logan bought it for her. Gustavo hangs BTR’s new gold record and Carlos and James wonder what would happen if they played it.

The guys accidentally destroy the tape of the new Big Time Rush episode they were supposed to give the network. Needing a replacement episode the guys decide to make a blooper show which Stephen Glickman and Ciara Bravo host.

Big Time Invasion: BTR has to stop the invasion of the British boy band! Concerned that Gustavo is spread too thin, the boys try to hire a top music manager. Unable to agree, the four split and a rift quickly escalates within the band.

Lucy releases her revenge album about Kendall and it becomes a huge hit! James, desperate for attention, creates a rumor that he and Cher Lloyd are recording a duet, and Carlos gets bad press after he appears to hit an old lady.

The guys are caught in a web of lies. Kendall has to keep Jo from discovering Lucy has returned to the Palm Woods. Logan’s fib about being sick turns into a medical emergency and Carlos and James claim Rocque Records was robbed.
Big Time Bonus: Gustavo gives the guys a bonus for their hard work, but they quickly begin to make bad decisions with their money.

BTR is making a cameo on a popular kid’s TV show, but Carlos’ pursuit of the show’s teen star puts him and Kendall in the crosshairs of her evil stage mother. Logan & James battle Yo Gabba Gabba over their amazing snack table.
It’s time again for the prank war at the Palm Woods, and this time it's kids versus adults as they battle for the honor of winning Lord Prankington’s Cup.

James continues his pursuit of Lucy and buys a motorcycle in order to impress her, but he doesn’t know how to drive it. Kendall teaches Jo how to drive stick-shift, and Carlos & Logan can’t relinquish a childhood treasure.
Logan brings Carlos along to the MCAT test as his good luck charm, but when Carlos somehow gets a higher score, Logan questions his plans to become a doctor.
The guys are pitched a kids cartoon show but instead do a video game to expand their brand. A mix-up while wearing motion capture suits puts them at the center of an extraterrestrial news story.
After being told that boy bands always split up after the third album, the guys compete to find solo “breakout” gigs before being left behind.

BTR is on tour with Victoria Justice and we go inside the guys’ bus to see the craziness that happens on board. When the guys get stuck in traffic, it is up to Victoria to keep the concert audience entertained until they arrive.

Big Time Dreams Pt. 1: It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show!  However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.
It’s the Tween Choice Awards, and BTR is nominated and booked to close the show! However, their night is in jeopardy when the guys uncover an evil plan to brainwash the audience.

Kendall, James, Logan and Carlos are hockey playing best friends from Minnesota, whose lives are turned upside down after mega-record producer discovers them and moves them to Los Angeles to make them into the next big boy band.

Kendall, Carlos, James, and Logan are required to attend four hours at school. However, instead of going to school at the Palmwoods Hotel, which they all have their own fantasies about, Gustavo insists that they attend school at his recording studio.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: I'll Cast a Spell on You

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Manga Artist's Brain, Nozaki-kun
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Nozaki needs inspiration for his artwork so Sakura decides to take him on what she believes is a date, but a few awkward encounters make her reconsider.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Prince (Girl) of the School's Problems

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Do You Have Enough Excitement?

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: What's Strengthened Is Our Bond and Our Reins

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Let's Rice
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: If This Feeling Isn't Love, Then There Is No Love in the World
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Yet Another Showdown! The Magical Girl has a Brand New Appearance?!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Urban Exploration! The Troubled Mikan and the Excited Demon
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Mikan realizes something - she recognizes the box that seals Shamiko's dad. That means the factory ruins on the outskirts of town hold clues about Momo's sister! Maybe.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Dark Witch Returns! With Steam From Hell!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: A New Species Discovered! The Town Café is a Demon Lair!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Demonic Awakening! Forge Your Own Path!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Vow Under the Setting Sun! The Path Forward for Demonkind

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: A Short Break!! The Demonic Summer Festival
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Shamiko's summer vacation has turned out far more hectic than intended. She tries to reclaim some peace in her life, but the looming stack of homework casts a dark shadow...

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Sparks Fly?! Light and Dark go on a Joint Excursion!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Shamiko promises to visit the zoo with Momo and Mikan and tries making boxed lunches for them. She'll need help to make something tasty, so Shamiko visits a certain address.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Pitch-Black Feelings!! Darkness Peach Returns!!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Ancestors Dojo?! Demonkind’s Ultimate Weapon!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: New Semester! The Magical Girl’s New Duty!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: A Ritual in Darkness! The Demon’s New Ally!!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse!

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Almighty Farming Tool
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The First Villager
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: More and More New Roommates
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Waterways Make Life Feel Complete
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: A Hospitable Heart
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Researcher and the Two Princesses
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: The Merchant and the Dragon
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Princess Yuri
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Everyday Life and the Progenitor
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Birth
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Not Enough Love Appeal!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: When Kanie collapses from exhaustion and a cold, Sento and the mascots take turns attending school as him utilizing a magical suit.

AnimexHIDIVE.us.st: Not Enough Teamwork!
AnimexHIDIVE.us.d: The Elementario fairies are a little frazzled as they attempt to work on a new show, and they just can't work together! Will they finally be able to become a team?

Avatar.de.d: Katara sets out to confront the Fire Nation soldier who killed her mother. However, no one knows what she will do when she finds him.
When the kids see a new play about themselves and all of their past adventures, they aren't happy with the production.
The kids learn new information about Firelord Ozai's master plan and decide to strike sooner than planned, but they are unsure if Aang is ready.
While Firelord Ozai begins his master plan, the gang tries to stop him. Meanwhile, Aang seeks advice from his past lives.
Suki, Toph, and Sokka try to stop the Fire Lord's fleet before they hit land, while Azula prepares for her coronation day.
Sokka and Toph manage to disable the airships while Zuko and Katara confront Azula. Aang finally faces off against the Fire Lord.
Katara and Sokka, a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe, discover a twelve-year-old boy frozen in an iceberg. Katara wonders if this boy is the Avatar whom the world has been awaiting.
Prince Zuko, a young Firebender whose mission in life is to capture the Avatar, tracks Aang down to the Southern Water Tribe village where Katara and Sokka live.
Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.
When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.
Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.
The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being Avatar.
During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.
When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.
Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.
When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.
A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.
When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.
Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives but they are so reliant that they are blind to the imminent danger they are all in.
Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.
Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.
After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.
The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.
The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help.
Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful `Avatar State' as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But it's more difficult than Aang thinks.
On the way to Omashu, the kids meet some nomads who show them a shortcut through the `cave of two lovers'. When they get lost in the caves, they must trust in love to escape.
The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi; however, when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands.
When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being `connected to the Earth' from an unlikely teacher.
Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates `Avatar Day'. They learn that it is not a celebration of the Avatar, but a festival of anger for something Aang did in his past.
In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.
Travelling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.
As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.
When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.
A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.
Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.
When the kids can't take the easy way into Ba Sing Se, they must escort a family of refugees there the hard way, through the deadly Serpent's Pass.

Despite the intervention of Sonic and Tails, Robotnik obtains the Chaos Emerald of life in prehistory and the other emeralds and becomes the Supreme High Robotnik.

Sonic and Tails babysit a trio of unruly baby beavers who end up being abducted by Scratch and Grounder. Robotnik uses the beavers as bait to capture Sonic and Tails, but the beavers become resourceful and help their friends thwart Robotnik.

KidsMovieClub.us.d: During Christmas time, Santa has just finished his worldwide deliveries, but an unthinkable tragedy occurs! Marshmallow, his most trusted reindeer, has forgotten an entire planet.
Whizzo the clown takes a bunch of kids on a magic carpet ride to North Pole to see Santa Claus, but not before the kids perform as circus animals in "Whizzoland."

After a rigorous journey through the Forest, Baby Bear and Benny realize that the perfect gift simply comes from the heart.

A Frozen Christmas is the perfect way to get the family in the Holiday spirit with the most beloved animated Christmas characters, including Santa Claus, the Snowman, Elves, Santa’s Reindeer, and more!
Join everybody s favorite playmates as they bring a world of Christmas adventure to life in these wonderful, stop-action holiday stories…
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
Santa's youngest son Arthur embarks on a magical adventure to deliver the final gift to a child to save Christmas.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: A Fright at the Opera
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: A homage to The Phantom of the Opera, as Nanny is kidnapped by The Phantom and Duckula must save her.

Count Duckula is approached to perform as a prince in a Hollywood film.

Professor Squakencluck shows off his time machine. However, when Penfold gets too close to the machine's targeted area, he is sucked into the past, 150 million years ago, in exchange for a dinosaur egg. Danger Mouse heads back to look for him.

Penfold and Danger Mouse journey to the center of the Earth to stop a loud noise that originates there.
Castle Duckula mistakedly lands in the middle of New York.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: Dr. Von Goosewing's Invisible Ray

Duckula experiences some real bad luck on Friday the 13th
Duckula becomes a private detective in Chicago.
Duckula, Igor and Nanny take a rollercoaster ride through time...literally!
Duckula becomes a deputy in the Wild West.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario and the Beanstalk

Greenback uses a spray on the world's leaders to cause them to laugh.
Bored with the look of the castle, Duckula hires a designer to redecorate the castle.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: Hunchbudgie of Notre Dame
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Duckula, Igor and Nanny are involved in a series of art thefts in Paris.

While vacationing in the canals of Venice, Danger Mouse and Penfold bump into a highway undergoing construction, being built by Baron Greenback, who holds a document that allows him to construct whatever he wants.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Danger Mouse and Penfold head to the North Pole on news that Baron Greenback and Stiletto have been selling over a thousand heat lamps to the Eskimos and causing the polar ice caps to melt.

PlutoTVRetroToons.de.t: Count Duckula: The Lost City of Atlantis
PlutoTVRetroToons.de.d: Count Duckula and co. are stuck on a tiny island.

Awkward.se.d: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.
Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.
Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.
Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.
Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.
Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
Awkward.se.st: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
Awkward.se.d: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?
Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.
Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
Awkward.se.d: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.
En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.
Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.
Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
Awkward.se.st: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
Awkward.se.d: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.
Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.
Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?
Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
Awkward.se.d: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.
Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.
Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
Awkward.se.d: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

Awkward.se.t: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
Awkward.se.st: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
Awkward.se.d: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.

Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.
Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.
I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.
Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.
Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.
Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.
Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.
Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.
Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.
Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

BroadCity.se.d: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.
Ilana leder febrilsk efter en gave i sidste øjeblik til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver at finde et klimaanlæg for at få det køligt i soveværelset.
Der dukker nye muligheder op, når Abbi endelig kan træne nogen på Soulstice og Ilana får succes som firmachef.

Abbi skal have sine visdomstænder trukket ud og Ilana ser det som sin pligt at passe hende til hun får det bedre - hvilket selvfølgelig indebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og et totalt mangel på tilsyn.
Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som slutter med en overraskelse. Ilana og hendes mor leder efter den perfekte håndtaske.
Pigerne leder efter den perfekte fest, hvilket afslører en underlig og surrealistisk side af Abbi, som bekræfter Ilanas værste anelser.
Slænget skal fejre, at Jaime er blevet amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers leder Abbi og Ilana på afveje ved at love dem gratis sprut. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare sig selv blandt alle advokaterne.
Abbi prøver at finde en forsvunden frakke, mens Ilana udforsker en ny romance - som føles besynderligt velbekendt.
Da pigerne fejrer Ilanas 23-års fødselsdag bliver de afbrudt af en bortløben teenager, der fører dem på en vildt jagt rundt i St. Mark's Place.
Abbi og Ilana får et tøjproblem på vej til en venindes udstilling og samtidig har de desperat brug for et offentligt toilet.
Abbi må lade, som om hun er Ilana for at tage hendes vagt på jobbet, mens Ilana tager til Long Island på grund af en meget vigtig lægeaftale.
Ilana får en ny mulighed på Deals, Deals, Deals, og Abbi prøver at holde sit konkurranceinstinkt i skak på Soulstice Games Day.
Efter at have modtaget en stor regning for skadedyrsbekæmpelse holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for at dække omkostningerne. I mellemtiden har Abbi en mission om at møde nye mennesker.
Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.
Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for at besøge Abbis barndomshjem . Da Abbi indser, at hun begik en stor fejl i high school, tager hun og Ilana ud på en forsoningsmission.
Abbi og Ilana lægger deres lejligheder ud på B & B-NYC for at tjene lidt ekstra penge.
Ilanas forældre kommer til byen til deres 30-års jubilæum, men Abbi og Ilana synes, det er svært at fejre, når de begge har samlivsproblemer.
Abbi og Ilana skal ud at rejse, men det er sværere at komme i lufhavnen end forventet.

BroadCity.se.t: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
BroadCity.se.d: Abbi får menses under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til værks for at finde en tampon.
På en forårsdag i 2011 mødes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.
Abbi vender tilbage til Soulstice, og det bliver interessant, da hun bliver tilbudt den træning, hun altid har drømt om. Ilana får et nyt job på en restaurant.
Iliana shopper vildt med sine drikkepenge fra servitricejobbet, og Abbi stråler i sit nye forhold. Senere den aften støder pigerne ind i en gammel ven til en fest.
Abbi og Ilana tager svampe og får et begivenhedsrigt trip.
Abbis mor kommer på besøg. Ilana skal forholde sig til den intense arbejdskultur på Sushi Mambeaux og sin sæsonbetingede affektive lidelse på samme tid.
Abbi føler sig gammel, da hun finder et gråt hår. Ilana går til en sexterapeut.
Abbi, Ilana, Eliot og Bobbi rejser til Florida for at rydde bedstemor Esthers lejlighed.
Abbi, Ilana, Jaime og Lincoln passer hus for Strands. Ilana og Lincoln definerer deres forhold, og Abbi har en Bumble-date med en mand fra sin fortid.
En smart ny taske giver Abbie selvtillid, mens hun er arbejdsløs.
Pigernes' 'vennilæum' udvikler sig i farlig retning, da de er vidne til noget forfærdeligt.
For at fejre Abbis 30-årsdag bevæger Abbi og Ilana sig fra Manhattans nordspids til sydspids og møder gamle og nye venner på vejen.

BroadCity.se.t: Broad City: SheWork and S**t Bucket
BroadCity.se.d: Ilana går i gang med sin seneste forretningsmulighed da hun åbner en udendørs-arbejdsplads for rygere i New York. Abbi konfronterer sin udlejer da han nægter at udskifte hendes rør.

BroadCity.se.t: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
BroadCity.se.d: Ilana besøger en eks for at indløse sine Bitcoins; Abbi afleverer sit vasketøj for første gang og mister sin yndlings-sweatshirt.
Ilana opdager en uhyggelig hemmelighed om Jaimé; Abbi forsøger at foretage springet fra sweater-folder til vinduesdesigner i Anthropologie.
Abbi bliver inviteret til en fancy kunstevent på MoMA; og Ilana og Lincoln gør forholdsstatus efter et år.
Pigerne møder Ilanas 16. fætter, der overlevede Holocaust, og tager ham med til en drag-brunch. Abbi afprøver et nyt look.
Ilana bliver hyret som hårmodel, Abbis nye flamme fortæller hende, at hun ikke er moden nok.
Abbi og Ilana besøger 'Sleep No More' og Abbi vil finde det rigtige tidspunkt til at fortælle Ilana en livsforandrende nyhed.
Abbi, Ilana og Bevers sælger Abbis New York-ting; Abbi skaffer billetter til en Lil Wayne-koncert og pigerne tager på et 'trip.'

CarolineintheCity.se.d: When Caroline discovers that only one newspaper in the country has not renewed her cartoon strip, she obsesses on the matter until finally convincing herself to face the editors in person.
Caroline has difficulty confronting her neglectful building superintendent, Mr. Tedescu about her faulty plumbing, so she hires a mediator to pressure Mr. Tedescu into taking care of her request.
Richard is stunned when his former love Julia informs him that she is about to be married.
In the ongoing charade of Caroline pretending that she and Richard are married.
A remorseful Caroline panics when she realizes that several hours have passed since she poured her heart out to Richard on his answering machine -- and she hasn't heard a response from him.

Caroline realizes that the constant aching in her neck could be related to the stress she feels over her unresolved feelings toward Richard, but she doesn't let it get in the way of helping Richard navigate through troubled waters with Julia.

Caroline feigns having read a writer’s novel to impress him, but their first date is a disaster as Caroline’s charade crumbles. Meanwhile, Richard jumps to Julia’s rescue when her waitress job at Remo’s leaves her customers hungry for attention.
When Caroline discovers that she’s been receiving free cable, her honesty with the cable company gets her into deep trouble with her not-so-truthful neighbors.
When Annie is visited by her old singing teacher, Miss McGowan, Caroline helps Annie pretend to still have her “Cats” role, an act that may have a surprise ending.
It’s a game of messy politics when Caroline will not endorse a local councilman, who is inspired by her comic strip, while Del conjures up a promotional campaign.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Used Car Salesman
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Discreetly planning to ease Caroline’s homesick holiday blues, Richard (Malcolm Gets) goes to great lengths to get a gift for Caroline that inspires suspicion in Julia (Sofia Milos) and sleuthing from Caroline and Annie.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Love That Dare Not Speak Its Name
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Informed by Annie (Amy Pietz) of Caroline’s (LeaThompson) unspoken love for him, Richard (Malcolm Gets) confronts Caroline, who tells him that it’s a thing of the past.
When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is tapped as a celebrity guest star for a quiz show, her jitters prompt Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help her study, much to Julia’s (Sofia Milos) chagrin.
Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to convince an insecure Del(Eric Lutes) that he has the potential to be a great parent after Del is shocked to discover that he is the father of a 10-year old girl.

When Julia (Sofia Milos) tells Caroline (Lea Thompson) that it’s not easy being on the outside of her close working relationship with Richard (Malcolm Gets), Caroline quickly, and mysteriously, learns what it’s like to walk a mile in Julia’s shoes.
As Caroline (Lea Thompson) struggles with commitment issues over Trevor, Richard(Malcolm Gets) inadvertently causes a rift between Caroline and her new beau.

When Caroline (Lea Thompson) is insulted by a local cabbie, Adamo, she takes her case to higher powers at the travel commission.  Meanwhile, Richard, frustrated by a “painter’s block,” becomes obsessed with computers when he joins a cyber cafe.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Visit From The Mom
CarolineintheCity.se.d: When Caroline’s (Lea Thompson)mother, Margaret Duffy (guest star Edie McClurg, “The Hogan Family”), visits Caroline for a mother-daughter People magazine shoot, tensions rise over unexpressed feelings.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline and the Marriage Counselor, Pt. 1
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Caroline (Lea Thompson) must hire a new cartoon colorist when Richard (Malcolm Gets) finally quits after he and Julia (Sofia Milos) move into their glamorous new home.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Guys In The Bathroom
CarolineintheCity.se.d: The fourth-season opener finds Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) savoring their first passionate kiss and preparing for romance.

Vengeful father-in-law Mr. Mazzone strips Richard (Malcolm Gets) of all his worldly possessions, forcing Richard to take temporary refuge in Caroline's (Lea Thompson) new office, where he runs afoul of Plum, the no-nonsense office manager.
After Caroline (Lea Thompson) inadvertently offends office manager Plum (guest star Nancy Lenehan, "Grace Under Fire"), she and Richard (Malcolm Gets) are banished to a damp, dark basement office.
After Annie (Amy Pietz) loses her boyfriend, her job and her agent, she impulsively accepts a date with her local drycleaner, Gil (guest star Ken Campbell),and spends an evening to remember.

Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) decide to go out on their first official "date" together on Halloween, but their romantic evening turns into fright night when Richard gets himself into a rooftop jam.

Caroline stumbles across Richard's (Malcolm Gets) divorce papers in his desk drawer, but an office mishap sends her on a frantic paper chase to retrieve the documents after they are lost in the interoffice mail.
Tired of losing acting roles to other, more well-endowed women, Annie (Amy Pietz) surprises the gang on Thanksgiving Day by announcing that she plans to get breast implants.
Richard gets an offer that his empty bank account can't refuse: his Aunt Frieda promises to give him $5,000 as a Bar Mitzvah gift if he agrees to finally go through the ceremony.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And The Big Bad Bed
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Richard (Malcolm Gets) agrees to let Reg become a houseguest after the cartoonist has a fight with his girlfriend, Wanda.
Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Del (Eric Lutes) experience mixed results when they become office mentors to a young cartoonist with an overactive libido and an eager marketing student.

Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to take Charlie (guest star Andy Lauer) under her wing and teach him the fundamentals of life after Del (Eric Lutes) is forced to fire the hapless in-line skater from his job at the greeting card company.

CarolineintheCity.se.st: Caroline And Joanie And The Stick
CarolineintheCity.se.d: Caroline (Lea Thompson) tries to right an old wrong by giving up a romantic weekend in Boston with Richard (Malcolm Gets) to help out a visiting childhood chum, Joanie (guest star Kelly Coffield), whom Caroline once bullied in school.
Caroline (Lea Thompson) and the gang visit Caroline's family home in Pestigo, Wisconsin, but the homecoming is ruined when her parents tell Caroline that they are selling the house.

Caroline (Lea Thompson) gives Richard(Malcolm Gets) a 7 p.m. deadline to make a marital commitment to her, then is coerced into spending the day making pottery with Del (Eric Lutes) and Annie (Amy Pietz) while she anxiously awaits his decision.
After deciding they can't wait to get married, Caroline (Lea Thompson) and Richard (Malcolm Gets) plan their nuptials for the following week.
As Caroline and Richard (Malcolm Gets) prepare to leave for Italy to visit his newborn son, Richard makes a confession that gives Caroline second thoughts about their future together.

Caroline Duffy (Lea Thompson) has her professional life just the way she wants it.  "Caroline in the City," the comic strip she created, turned into merchandising gold with an array of greeting cards, books and calendars.
Caroline and Del are moments away from departing for a weekend trip to Atlantic City when Richard bursts into the apartment with news that he has been mugged.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: Frasier's delight at having his caricature displayed in a famous local landmark dissolves once he sees the unflattering portrait.
The arrival of Daphne's obnoxious brother, Simon, unleashes an emotional torrent that drives her into therapy.
Just when Daphne decides to profess her love for Niles, he drops a stunning bombshell.
On the eve of her wedding, Daphne's torn between the man she loves and the man she's engaged to marry.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.st: And the Dish Ran Away with the Spoon - Part 1
CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: Niles and Daphne flee the wedding altar but soon discover the heavy price to pay for admitting their true love as jilted groom Donny and bitter wife Mel seek revenge.

CheersPlusFrasier.us.st: And the Dish Ran Away with the Spoon - Part 2
CheersPlusFrasier.us.d: Mel agrees to divorce Niles, but she forbids him to date Daphne.
Frasier takes the bus with Roz for the first time, and Frasier uses Martin to meet a woman at a retirement home. Niles and Daphne recreate a date.
Frasier adopts the role of cultural mentor to Todd Peterson, a Silicon Valley billionaire who's just become the station's new owner.
Tension builds as Mel subjects Niles to social humiliation before granting him a divorce. Finally, he can no longer endure the disrespect, and the situation explodes at a party.

Donny drops the lawsuit against Frasier and Daphne because he's met another woman whom he has decided to marry. Frasier dates his lawyer, Abbey, but accuses her of overcharging him for legal expenses.
Frasier betrays Roz by staying friends with her cheating ex-boyfriend.
Frasier reluctantly co-hosts Seattle's Christmas parade with his radio rival.
Frasier is awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award. Martin, his father, accepts on his behalf because Frasier is off analyzing his own life with his old Harvard mentor, Professor Tewsbury.
Frasier decides that three generations of Crane men should head out to the woods for some family bonding, despite their protests.
Frasier and Niles go back to school to learn about auto mechanics.
Frasier and Niles try to revitalize the career of their boyhood Shakespearean actor/idol, only to learn that he stinks.
Frasier's dating destiny unfolds in a pair of parallel universes.
Niles and Daphne decide to go on a diet. Roz tries a new pheromonal perfume that attracts men. Frasier goes on a date with Eileen, Kenny's wife.
After Niles sinks an impossible half-court shot, Frasier finds him impossible to live with.
Roz puts together a space documentary with Senator John Glenn. Niles learns to fly a kite.
Frasier and Niles press Martin's rich girlfriend to save their bankrupt prep school.

Frasier leaves his wine club to host a new radio feature called "The Wine Corner" and is angered to learn that a resentful Niles, the club's overbearing "corkmaster," has ordered its old members not to participate in the program.
Niles and Daphne "get real" about their romance and their idealized impressions of each other.
Daphne attempts to prove to Niles that she has psychic visions, and Frasier is ego-stricken when he discovers that Roz is having an affair with his mentor.
Frasier runs into an old high school friend and finds that he is attracted to her friend, Claire.
Frasier tutors Lana's son in exchange for a date with Claire. Martin goes to a dog party, and Daphne and Niles have trouble sleeping in the same bed.
Frasier's vacation plans with Claire turn disastrous when Daphne, Niles, and Martin show up at the same resort and Frasier starts dreaming about Lana.

Niles gets jealous of an old flame of Daphne's at the dog park; Frasier teaches Lana about honesty in selling a problematic piece of real estate, and Martin secretly attends the parole hearing of the man who shot him.
Frasier has trouble deciding between two women and ends up losing them both. Niles mistakenly goes to a local beach in the buff.
Troubled by his recent relationship woes, Frasier goes to the country for peace and quiet, but ends up facing the ghosts of failed relationships past.
Daphne is tortured by pangs of jealousy when she learns one of Niles's patients is in love with him. Frasier and Martin go to extreme lengths to catch a cricket hiding in the apartment.
Martin goes back to work as a security guard and reflects on his last day as a cop, when he was shot.

Roz comes face-to-face with her own snobbery when she dates a garbage man. Frasier's plan to convince his co-workers that he isn't an elitist snob backfires when he becomes more popular than he wants.

ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Mike learns the secret to business in psychology class.
Robbie's class project involves making investments.
Bub's old friend, a baseball team manager, comes to town to accept an award.

Gloria is reading over an old love letter that Mike had sent her. This leads to a conversation between Gloria and Edith concerning an old flame of Edith's. Archie hits the roof and demands that Edith not keep any secrets from him.
Edith's cousin, Maude, invites Archie and Edith to the wedding of her daughter, Carol. However, Carol and Maude are not looking forward to Archie, since the man she is marrying happens to be Jewish.
Felix directs a movie built around Oscar's day-by-day activities.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Pig Who Came to Dinner
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Bobby Riggs plays himself -- a male chauvinist hustler -- and Billie Jean King pops in as his ping-pong opponent, to the surprise of Felix and Oscar.
Felix finds a virago of a housekeeper to take care of Oscar while he is recuperating at home from an ulcer attack.
Felix hears things go bump in the night and is convinced that he and Oscar are sharing their apartment with the ghost of a previous tenant.
When Felix refuses to lend financial assistance to Oscar to back a dubious invention, Oscar finds another way of getting the money.
Felix finds Oscar moonlighting as a counterman in a dingy diner after Oscar backed a wrong horse with money Felix had advanced him for another purpose.
In order to win favor with his new girlfriend, Oscar goes on a neatness kick, with Felix's warm support and cooperation.
Oscar tries to cure Felix of his fear of flying so he can cover a major photographic assignment.
Rob feels very much the hero when he hires a maid for his overworked wife, Laura.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Sound of the Trumpets of Conscience Falls Deafly on a Brain That Holds Its Ears...
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Rob struggles between his civic duty and fear for his family's safety when he believes he can identify the two robbers in a jewelry store holdup.
It's the first Christmas presentation of 'The Alan Brady Show' where he turns the spotlight upon his talented staff to entertain the TV public.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Third One from the Left
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: A young chorus girl on 'The Alan Brady Show' falls desperately in love with Rob.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: My Husband Is the Best One
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Rob's job is threatened by a news article praising him more than Alan for the success of 'The Alan Brady Show.'

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Lady and the Tiger and the Lawyer
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: When a handsome bachelor moves in next door, Rob and Laura become matchmakers.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: The Life and Love of Joe Coogan
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: Rob is overwhelmed by jealousy when he meets one of Laura's old flames and later discovers that she saved a box of love poems he sent her.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: A Nice, Friendly Game of Cards
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: A social game of poker turns sour when it's discovered Rob has been playing with a marked deck.

ClassicTVComedy.us.st: Happy Birthday and Too Many More
ClassicTVComedy.us.d: When Laura and Rob give Ritchie a birthday party, 63 screaming kids cause a ruckus at the Petrie house.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksfangerne
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris forsøger at hjælpe Malvo, en vaneforbryder, som lige er blevet løsladt fra fængslet, med at ændre sit liv ved at gå tilbage til high school.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Jordens dag
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris skal finde på et skoleprojekt til Jordens dag, så han indsamler tomme dåser i den tro, at det vil blive en let opgave, som Julius kan hjælpe ham med.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at være cool
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris er på en mission for at blive en af de ”cool” børn og bliver taget med cigaretter og bortvist fra skolen.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gallafesten i 9. klasse
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris og Greg har ingen dates til gallafesten i 9. klasse, men så bliver Greg inviteret med, så Chris må gå alene. Miss Morello foreslår, at Chris inviterer den eneste pige, der ikke har en date endnu, Carrie White, og hun siger ja.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mors dag
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris vil købe en flaske dyr parfume til sin mor til mors dag for at takke hende for alt det, hun har gjort for ham.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader dimissionen
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris’ glæde over at dimittere fra high school bliver ødelagt, da Greg meddeler, at han skal på en anden high school til efteråret.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tattaglia
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Som førsteårselev i high school glæder Chris sig til at gå i en skole, der har lidt mere mangfoldighed.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader kage
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris siger ja til at hjælpe klassekammeraten Angel med at forbedre sine karakterer, hvis Angel vil hjælpe ham med at fange Chris’ nyeste flamme, Marias, opmærksomhed.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Homecoming
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris er i syvende himmel, da en sød pige, Jenise Huckstable, inviterer ham til Tattaglia Homecoming-festen.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader engelsklæreren
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Julius og Rochelle hæver mr. Omars husleje, kræver han, at de renoverer lejligheden, og han flytter ind hos Chris’ familie, indtil reparationerne er færdige.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader min mand
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris opdager, at når han hjælper skolens populære running back og hans venner med lektierne, så får han lov til at hænge ud med de cool børn.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Docs
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Docs irriterende nye kæreste, Stacy, gør Chris’ liv til et helvede, beslutter Chris sig for at skille parret ad.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sladrehanke
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Selv om Chris bør være hjemme og passe Drew og Tonya, sniger han sig i biografen med sine venner og bliver vidne til en skudepisode ved biografen.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Big Bird
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris er endelig begyndt at falde til på sin nye skole, da han bliver inviteret på date af skolens mest nørdede pige, Kelly, som alle kalder for ”Big Bird”.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader James
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Julius indser, at han kan holde Rochelle lykkelig i ægteskabet ved at bruge gode råd fra ”The Oprah Winfrey Show”. Men desværre giver planen bagslag, da Rochelle tror, at Julius’ ændrede indstilling kommer på grund af en affære.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader nytårsaften
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris er fast besluttet på at tilbringe nytårsaften på Times Square, men Rochelle siger, at Chris kun må tage af sted, hvis han finder en ansvarsfuld voksen at tage med.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mr. Levine
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Rochelle bestiller en kopi af sin fødselsattest, opdager hun, at hun er et år yngre, end hun troede, og hun begynder at leve sit liv med en ny og mere ungdommelig indstilling.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sportsjakker
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris og Greg melder sig til wrestlingholdet for at få en sportsjakke og imponere damerne.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader falsk id
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris og Greg er nødt til at skaffe falsk id, ellers kan de ikke tage til en Fat Boys-koncert. Rochelle planlægger en surprisefest for Julius.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader egnethedsprøver
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris ved, at han skal have høje point for at blive optaget på college og beslutter sig for at terpe til sin PSAT-prøve. Da Rochelle tvinger familien ud til et arrangement, har Chris ikke tid til at læse og vælger at købe svarene til prøven.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader boksning
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Træner Thurman ser Chris blive mobbet af Caruso og foreslår ham at lære at bokse, så han kan forsvare sig selv.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader lasagne
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris går modvilligt med til at opbevare noget pot for en forbryder på flugt, men han har svært ved at finde et gemmested, der ikke får ham i knibe.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader forårsferien
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris kommer til at køre ind i Greg, da han prøvekører pedellens bil, og Greg ender på hospitalet med et brækket ben. Da begge Gregs forældre er ude at rejse, aflyser Rochelle familieferien, så hun kan passe Greg.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader bilen
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Chris får sit kørekort, giver Rochelle og Julius ham lov til at købe en bil, men da bilen bliver stjålet og vandaliseret, indser Chris, hvor stort et ansvar det er at eje en bil.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader flabethed
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris siger fra over for sin mor, Rochelle, og nægter at udføre sine huslige pligter, hvilket får Rochelle til at beklage sig til Julius over, at hendes søn er respektløs.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tasha
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris samler mod til at spørge Tasha, om hun vil være hans kæreste, og bliver overrasket, da hun siger ja. Men desværre vidste Chris ikke, at forholdet betyder, at han skal opgive al sin fritid og kun lave det, som Tasha har lyst til.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader bombetrusler
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Som straf for Chris’ afbrydelse af historietimen får han og hans klassekammerater til opgave at lære en berømt tale fra 2. verdenskrig udenad og recitere den for hele klassen.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksamen
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: I skoleårets sidste uge får Chris at vide, at hvis han kommer for sent igen, så skal han gå året om.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader piloten
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da familien flytter til et nyt nabolag og en næsten helt hvid skole to timer væk fra de strenge og arbejdsomme forældre, kæmper Chris for at finde sit ståsted, mens han passer sine små søskende og prøver at håndtere skolens bølle, Joey.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Keisha
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Chris’ mor, Rochelle, ansætter nabopigen, Keisha, til at hjælpe Drew med matematik, ser Chris det som den perfekte chance for at imponere hende. Men andre har muligvis samme plan.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader basketball
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris melder sig til skolens baskethold, selv om han ikke kan spille, men en dumpet prøve truer med at få ham smidt af holdet. Derhjemme får Julius en ny lejer, som tilbyder at betale et halvt års husleje, selv om han gør Rochelle nervøs.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader pølse
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Julius køber en stor kasse pølser, tvinger han alle til at spise det til alle måltider. Men det nægter Tonya, og det skaber spændinger mellem hende og Rochelle.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Fede Mike
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris lader et af børnene fra nabolaget låne sin cykel, selv om Julius advarer ham mod det, og drengen stjæler den.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader halloween
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Det er halloween, og Chris bliver ellevild, da en pige inviterer ham til kostumefest. Men Caruso har planer med ham …

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader babysitteren
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Da Julius og Rochelle holder dateaften, hyrer de en babysitter. Men Chris bliver nødt til at tage over, da hun er nødt til at gå for at tage sig af noget.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader møntvaskeriet
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Mens Julius og Rochelle tager ud for at købe nyt tv, skal Chris have sine søskende med på møntvaskeri. Men det hele går galt, da Tonya stormer ud.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader madkuponer
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Julius finder 200 dollar i madkuponer, men Rochelle er for flov til at vise dem til Sheila, så hun begynder at bruge af opsparingen, da hun handler ind.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Greg
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris og Greg bliver uvenner, da de bryder ”ingen computerspil”-reglen hjemme hos Greg efter skole. Hjemme hos familien Rock savner Tonya Chris, fordi hun ikke kan give ham skylden for alt.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader jul
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Det er jul, og Julius og Rochelle har svært ved at fortælle familien, at de ikke har råd til gaver, fordi vandvarmeren er i stykker. Chris bliver overrasket, da han finder ud af, hvem madindsamlingen går til.

EverybodyHatesChris.se.t: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader deltidsarbejde
EverybodyHatesChris.se.d: Chris er træt af at skulle bruge Drews gamle vinterjakker og beslutter sig for, at en læderjakke vil få ham til at se mere cool ud. Men han lærer lidt om penges værdi, da han tager på arbejde med sin far for at tjene penge til at købe en.

Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.
