KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
KeyPeele.se.d: To gamle damer slås mod Satan, ting går galt når en mand vil købe en ny madras og gæsterne på en klub tvinges til at se sandheden om sig selv.
Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.
Sketches inkluderer en fyr, der jagter sin kæreste til Jordens ende og LMFAO, der ikke kan holde op med at feste.
Rumvæsner invaderer jorden, en familie forliger sig med en slægtnings homobryllup og nogle racister udtrykker nogle overraskende meninger.
Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der ikke får lov at gå om bord i en flyver, en bølle, der nægter at hælde en flaske sprut ud og en bokser, der sviner sin modstander til.
Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper af derhjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobinterview, en skrædder får en klient med luft i maven, parkeringsvagterne diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonsælger prøver en ny strategi.
Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

Præsident Obama og hans vredesoversætter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møder manden, der skulle tale efter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner taler om, hvad der sker med deres bæ, efter de skyller ud.
Sketches inkluderer et rumvæsen, der lærer om kvindelig anatomi, fyrene der prøver at overgå hinanden og mødet mellem de to sidste mennesker på Jorden.
Sketches inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn, der glæder sig over fordelene ved deres nu lovlige ægteskab, en politibetjent, der møder sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' bliver forfulgt af en superfan.
Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: Bone Thugs And Homeless
KeyPeele.se.d: Sketches inkluderer en hund, der plager en nyhedsreporter og Harriet Tubman, der løber frit omkring.
Sketches inkluderer vikaren fra den indre by Mr. Garvey og A-Aron, Jordans kæreste tager ham i at se porno og fyrene laver sjov med Les Mis.

I denne seriepremiere af komedieprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key at sige et forbudt ord om deres kvinder, Lil Wayne vænner sig til livet bag tremmer og præsident Obama udtrykker, hvad han virkelig føler.

KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
KeyPeele.se.st: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap
KeyPeele.se.d: Sketches inkluderer All-Stars fra East/West bowl, der rapper, fyrene spiller mafioso, og de to parkeringsfyre har svært ved at tro, at nogen tør provokere Batmans.
Sketches inkluderer en polterabend, der bliver mærkelig og en sort fyr med en hvid penis.

En PSA arbejder med børnesoldater i Afrika, en college-a-cappella-gruppe får et nyt medlem, Meegan og André går på deres første date, en terrorgruppe har en foodtruck og to gamle mænd diskuterer popmusik.
Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.
Jordan og Keegan forsøger at gemme sig fra en negerjagtende nazist. Andre sketches inkluderer to slaver, der har svært ved at blive solgt, et par bøller, der kommer i knibe før et stort kup.
Sketcherne inkluderr en introduktion af de nyeste East/West Bowl-spillere, udlejer-Devon ransager Jordans lejlighed, og Jordan bliver stødt af en overseksuel kollega.
En gospel-gruppe må øve sig uden deres lærer, en gruppe krigere fejrer en halshugning, en fange forsøger at narre fængselsvagten og en ung mand bliver konfronteret fordi han kun taler i floskler.

En respekteret kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrydelser, bruger ukonventionelle metoder for at løse en sag, en actionhelt redder sin kæreste og en ansat i en forretning med yoghurtis tester for mange vareprøver.

Jordan og Keegan fyrer den af foran et opstemt publikum, en trafikreporter bliver udsat for turbulens i en helikopter og halvdelen af en R&B duo afslører sine sande følelser for sin partner under en optræden.

Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

En steward skal håndtere en passager, som ikke vil spænde selen, britiske opdagelsesrejsende diskuterer deres rejser, to par forsøger at undgå spoilers på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe oplever en guddommelig intervention.
Sketches inkluderer gangstere, der er vilde med 'Twilight,' besøg til en verden, hvor navnene er prutter og racistiske superhelte.
En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.
Ray Parker Jr. har nogle nye sange, en mand kan ikke lade være med at sige 'deez nuts', Keegan må ringe til 112 og en ung mand lærer om Negrotown.

Jordan og Keegan spiller to mystikere, der kæmper om rettigheden til at give skarpsindige råd. Andre sketches inkluderer Jaden Smith og hans agent, der diskuterer et nyt manuskript og et bøssepar, der 'fejrer' ny lovgivning.
Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver lidt for høj, en fodboldspiller, der vil gøre alt for at få det røde kort, og to sexeksperter, der giver råd om cunnilingus.
Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.
Sketches inkluderer at fyrene har en dårlig Skype-forbindelse, en Django Unchained-slavekamp og en baseballspiller, der klasker røv for meget.
I sæsonfinalen vil præsident Obama behandles ligesom alle andre, Jordan ser på en lejlighed, som er ejet af en mistænksom vicevært og et par festaber, der vil få gang i festen til en bar mitzvah.

KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
KeyPeele.se.d: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klub, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et interview, Conrad flyver business class og Keegan har et nyt overskæg.

KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
KeyPeele.se.d: Inkluderer sketcher hvor Keegan og Jordan aflytter hvide kvinder, der elsker sorte mænd, Wendell laver en musikvideo, og Kareem og Jahar går i fitnesscenteret.

KeyPeele.se.t: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
KeyPeele.se.d: Et football-hold hyper sig før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møder Hillary Clinton, to fyre forbereder sig på potentielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er lidt for skydeglad.
En fodboldspiller med hjerneskade prøver at inspirere sit hold, en mand anklager sin kone for at være utro med en hund og en restaurantejer skræmmer sine gæster væk.
Sketches inkluderer en fodboldspiller, der bliver straffet for at juble for meget, Jordan og Keegan går til premiere på 'Othello' og en high school-elev bliver berømt for at stjæle en vittighed.
En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

Klovn.se.d: Mia bjuder med Frank på en avslappnande spa-weekend på hotell, men det blir trassel med såväl kama sutra som tarmsköljning. Casper rymmer från sjukhuset och Frank måste leta upp honom.

Frank, Mia, Casper och Iben åker på en weekend-tripp till Dragsholms slott, tillsammans med Lars Hjorthøj och hans fru Tina. Kvinnorna ser fram emot en lugn och skön helg, medan grabbarna vill hänga runt och jaga, men allt spårar ur snabbt.

Frank och Mia tittar på ett hus där den förre ägarens fru är död, men kroppen aldrig hittades. Niels berättar hemligheten bakom Bispebjerg-tricket för Casper och Frank - det närmaste man kan komma sex med någon annan utan att vara otrogen.

Frank väntar otåligt på att vännen och kollegan Casper ska bli bättre och under tiden hjälper han Mia lite halvt i te-butiken. Plötsligt vaknar Casper till och har en ny idé. Mias 12-årige brorson är på besök och Frank tycker att de är konstiga.

Frank och Mia har flyttat till landet och går på en boskapsutställning tillsammans med Casper. Dagen där på upptäcker Mia att de köpt en ko. För att lära känna lokalbefolkningen ställer Frank och Mia upp i stadens årliga skådespel.
Frank och Mia åker på skidsemester tillsammans med Iben och Casper. Ett prat om orgasmer leder till både en obekväm situation och tankar på giftermål.
Frank och Mia ska köpa ett begagnat piano. När Frank får reda på att säljaren är muslim tar han över förhandlingarna. Sådana saker kräver en man.
Frank vill gå med i cykellaget ”Mountain Lions”. Erik Clausen är lagets nestor, men är allvarligt sjuk. Frank gör allt han kan för att leva upp till kraven.

Frank är ute efter hämnd efter det att Mia blivit förödmjukad av Per Pallesen i sin tesalong. Lene får besök av en god gammal norsk vän som driver Casper till vansinne med vilda machohistorier från Norge. Alltid mer vilda än något Casper har upplevt.
Man är missnöjd i området med den obehagliga, men duktiga slaktaren Lund. Så när Frank får en ”tjänst till godo” i den kriminella världen beslutar han sig för att lära slaktare Lund en läxa.

Frank får den sorgliga nyheten att en god vän är död. Det handlar om en förfärlig frysboxolycka. När Frank får reda på att frysboxen senare är till salu blir han otroligt arg och beslutar sig för att själv rätta till saken.

Mia är väldigt imponerad över livsstilsexperterna i ”Känner du till typen”. Det irriterar Frank. Det krävs ingen särskild talang för det, hävdar han. På en middag hos Casper får Frank chansen att ”battla” med en äkta expert – och så går det som det går.

Casper letar efter en så kallad ”god vilja-present” till Lene, vilket alltid är ett högriskprojekt. Och Frank hamnar i en bitter grannstrid med två nyinflyttade kvinnor på gatan. Vem är mest kränkt? Den som kissar eller den som tittar på den som kissar?

Frank har fått en liten depression. Casper har många bra idéer om hur Frank kan bli på bättre humör, och snart är Frank inblandad i både muggmålning och en Silas Holst-musikal. Men räcker det för att pigga upp en medelålders man?
Frank och Mia inspireras till att försöka sig på en trekant. En rutinerad Casper övertygar Frank om att det ska vara med en man den första gången.
Frank överraskar Mia med en romantisk prinsessdag. Den är planlagd in i minsta detalj med hjälp av Casper och B.S. Christiansen. Inget kan gå fel. Men det kan det. Extremt fel.
Carøe får hjälp med att ta sig ur en nödsituation, ett SOS. Frank lyckas dock på sedvanligt pinsamt manér att vända det till att de i stället alla råkar i trubbel.
Frank och Casper anställer Bo som assistent på kontoret. Båda tycker att de är som gjorda för att åtgärda hans ungdomsapati, men det råder delade meningar om vilken metod som är den rätta.
Susan har satt en otrohetslockfågel på Carøe. Till de flestas förtret. Mia tycker däremot att Susan visar att hon är en stark och modig kvinna som går på sina känslor.
Vem är Balling och vem är Bahs av Frank och Casper? De tycker inte alls likadant. Kanske kan ett avföringsprov lösa tvisten.
Mias familj får veta att pappa Oles sista önskan var att han skulle begravas och inte kremeras. De måste nu arrangera hans begravning fem år efter hans död.
Mia är på skrivarkurs i Afrika. Så Frank har ansvaret för Pykker som har brutit armen. Frank utnyttjar möjligheten att festa med Casper och de två enas fort om att Mia offrar sig för lite för Frank.
Nu är det Franks tur att glänsa. Han har blivit gästföreståndare på Hingebjergs folkhögskola. Men Frank får väldigt bråttom med att sätta sig själv i centrum.
Frank får lov att vara med i den förnäma filmklubben Les amis du Cinema. Men han kan inte följa klubbens regler, så det går inte särskilt bra för honom.
Revisor-Kurt övertalar Frank och Casper om att de ska investera i en lyxyacht. Det visar sig dock att det kanske inte var någon bra idé.

Äntligen har Frank lyckats bli nominerad till at få en teaterminnesplatta på Frederiksberg Allé. Han får Mia att hjälpa till med smöra på rätt ställen. Ännu en gång går det dock inte som Frank har förväntat sig.

Klovn.se.t: Klovn: Ett Porträtt Av En Tennisklubb
Klovn.se.d: Frank använder alla knep för att vinna den årliga tennisturneringen. Som vanligt är det mest Frank själv som drabbas av sina lömska planer.
Frank ska på återträffsfest på sin gymnasieskola. Han vill framstå som framgångsrik, inte minst inför Rikke, som var hans crush i gymnasiet.

Frank känner sig särskilt utvald när han ska delta i ett forskningsprojekt, som Eske Willerslev lite av en tillfällighet bjudit in honom till. Frank visar sig snabbt ha haft mycket överdrivna förväntningar på vilken position han ska ha i projektet.

Frank solar sig i glansen av att han ska hålla ett klimatal under politikerveckan på Bornholm. Tyvärr stjäl Bjarne Corydon all uppmärksamhet efter en hjältemodig räddningsaktion. Frank gör sitt bästa för att få fokus flyttat från Corydon till sig själv.

Frank, Casper, Mia och Fnug åker på parresa till Hornbæk. Mia vill helst mysa med Frank, Frank kämpar med att lyckas ladda sin elbil och Casper måste tyvärr medge att Fnug är ung och har många unga vänner i området.
Frank får bli medlem i CC:s herrklubb, där det talas om allvarliga känslor av existensiell karaktär. Mia har stora problem med klimakteriesymptom.

ManwithaPlan.se.d: Adam og Andi bliver chokerede, da de endelig møder Lowells kone, Jen.
Da Adam overtaler sin stædige far til endelig at gå til lægen, får han nogle ting at vide, som hans far ikke ønskede, at han skulle vide.
Adam og Don opdager en snedig måde at undgå problemer med deres koner på.
Adam gør alt for at beskytte sin brors følelser, da en klient ikke vil have ham med til deres møde. Andi fedter desuden for fru Rodriguez for at sikre sig, at Emma får den bedste lærer.
Adam og Andi låner penge af Joe, men det fortryder de hurtigt igen.
Da Adam og Andi opdager, at Kate lyver for dem om, hvor hun befinder sig, udtænker de en plan for at fange hende.
Adam og Andi leger med tanken om at få endnu et barn, da Don og Marcys nyfødte barnebarn kommer på besøg.
Andi hyrer en smuk, ung babysitter, Sophia, til at passe børnene, og hun bliver jaloux, da hendes datter Kate går til Sophia for at få råd i stedet for Andi.
Da Adam opdager, at præsten, der viede dem, var en svindler, og at han og faktisk Andi ikke rigtig er gift, forsøger han at finde en måde at løse situationen på, før hun lægger mærke til noget.
Børnene gider ikke gøre deres pligter, så Adam og Andi beslutter sig for også at strejke.
Da Adam mistænker, at Kates kæreste ryger hash, beslutter han sig for at konfrontere ham – men Andi giver ham ikke den støtte, han havde forventet.
Adam skal ansætte en ny projektleder, men han interviewer kun mænd til jobbet, så Andi beskylder ham for at agere på ubevidste fordomme.
Ingen dukker op til Adam og Andis fællesspisning, så de forsøger at komme tilbage i deres naboers gunst.
Adam og Andi bliver overrasket af uventede udgifter, så de beslutter hver især at give afkald på noget for at betale dem.
Adam tager sine børn med på arbejde, men de kommer ved et uheld til at give hans største kunde lus – og Andi føler sig som en dårlig mor, da hun er den eneste i familien, der ikke får lus.
Adam opdager, at hans far er ved at blive mere og mere glemsom, men han har svært ved at finde ud af, hvordan han skal snakke med ham om det.
Adam og Andi bliver enige om at fejre Valentinsdag uden gaver, så Adam giver Andis gave til sin mor i stedet.

ManwithaPlan.se.st: Guess Who's Coming to Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner
ManwithaPlan.se.d: Andi skaffer Bev en plads som frivillig på hospitalet, så Joe keder sig og begynder at tilbringe for meget tid sammen med Adam.
Andi og Adam er uenige om, hvorvidt Kate må tage til en fest med en ældre dreng, så Adam forsøger at udmanøvrere Andi for at vinde diskussionen.
Adam forsøger at arrangere en fødselsdagsmiddag for Andi, men han opdager snart, at det ikke er helt let at holde styr på sine gæster.
Adam og Andi mister en sexvideo, som de tog ved et uheld, så de er nødt til at finde den, før nogen anden gør.
Andis forældre beslutter sig for at besøge familien til påske, så Adam og Andi bliver nødt til at bevare freden mellem begge forældrepar.
Adam insisterer på, at pranks er harmløse, så Andi udtænker en udspekuleret spøg for at give ham en lærestreg.
Adam bliver fast besluttet på at finde ud af, hvad Andi egentlig går og skjuler, da han opdager, at hun har holdt hemmeligheder for ham for hans eget bedste.
Adam er glad og beæret over at skulle hjælpe Joe med at købe en ny bil, men han bliver forbavset, da Joe pludselig bliver irritabel, og forhandlingerne kører af sporet.
Adam og Don indser, at de er nødt til at skaffe flere kunder, så de optager en reklamefilm for deres firma. Andi tager derudover mod til sig og beder sin chef, Bob, om lønforhøjelse.
Adam og Andi arrangerer en date for Adams chef for at få hende på bedre humør i håb om, at hun så vil lade Adam genoptage arbejdet på indkøbscentret.
Da Andi ikke kan finde arbejde, foreslår hun, at Adam og hun skal starte en forretning sammen. Adam tager desuden fat på sit livs mest udfordrende opgave, nemlig at renovere Joe og Bevs køkken.
Adam forsøger at få kontoret til at virke mere indbydende, fordi Andi snart skal være på arbejdet med ham hver dag. Desuden har Lowell skjult en livsændrende hemmelighed.

Adam og gutterne besøger Lowell i hans nye ungkarlebolig – og begynder at hænge ud der for at komme lidt væk fra deres liv derhjemme. Andi presser Adam til at give hende sit eget skrivebord på kontoret.
Da Adam fanger Kate i at snige sig ind i huset om natten, er han fast besluttet på at rette op på denne adfærd ved hjælp af gammeldags opdragelsestaktikker.
Adam og Andi gør sig store anstrengelser for at sikre et lån til at løse et uventet problem på det hus, som de har tænkt sig at istandsætte og videresælge.
Teddy sover gang på gang i Adam og Andies seng, så de bliver snart ivrige efter at booke en hotelovernatning. Kate får lov til at blive hjemme, men hun følger ikke Adam og Andis strenge regler.
Adam tilbyder Kate at begynde at spise vegansk for at komme tættere på hende, men hans kærlighed til kød viser sig at være en svær vane at bryde.
Selv efter at Adam har fået en rygskade på sin 50-års fødselsdag, er han stadig fast besluttet på at tage en tur på dirt bike, så han kan krydse det af på sin bucket list.
Adam bliver jaloux, da Teddy fremhæver Andi som sin helt i en skoleopgave.
Da Adam ved et uheld inviterer Andi med på den årlige drengetur, forsøger han at få hende til at melde afbud, hvilket kun gør det hele værre.

en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

SitcomLegends.us.d: A CSI team investigates a mysterious death at Charlie's house. George Eads ("CSI: Crime Scene Investigation") makes a cameo appearance.
Charlie finds himself attracted to Angie (recurring guest star SUSAN BLAKELY), an older woman who writes self-help books. Meanwhile, Alan and Jake battle over a school assignment.
Charlie tries to resist temptation when he meets the grown daughter of the woman he's dating (SUSAN BLAKELY) and realizes they've met before. JANE LYNCH guest stars as Dr. Freeman.
On the sixth season premiere, Charlie (series star CHARLIE SHEEN) encounters an ex-girlfriend (guest star RENA SOFER - "24") whose son looks an awful lot like him.
Alan (series star JON CRYER) lends Charlie money and crosses a line in his attempts to get it back.
Charlie tries cooking, Alan tries dating two women at the same time and Jake (series star ANGUS T. JONES) tries beer.
Charlie romances Alan's sweet receptionist (guest star KELLY STABLES) as Alan anxiously awaits disaster.
The guys bump into Jake's former teacher (guest star ALICIA WITT) who became a stripper after a fling with Charlie. Charlie tries to help her out, but things spiral out of control.
When Judith (series star MARIN HINKLE) kicks Herb (recurring star RYAN STILES) to the curb, Alan comes knocking.
Alan tries to escape Judith's grasp as Charlie and Herb go on the prowl.
Charlie's new girlfriend, Chelsea (guest star JENNIFER TAYLOR), asks him to spend the night at her place, while Alan tries to enforce a punishment on Jake.
Jake disappears with the daughter of Charlie's neighbor, a former NFL player (guest star MICHAEL CLARKE DUNCAN), and Charlie is left to cover his back.

SitcomLegends.us.st: He smelled the ham, he got excited
SitcomLegends.us.d: Evelyn offers to pay for Jake's college education, leaving Alan to wonder if he ever needs to work again.
Charlie Sheen's brother, EMILIO ESTEVEZ, and JAMES EARL JONES guest star in an episode where Charlie reevaluates his reckless lifestyle when one of his friends dies.
Charlie and Jake fight for the affections of a waitress (guest star EMILY ROSE), while Alan fights sexual tension with his receptionist, Melissa (guest star KELLY STABLES).
Judith is pregnant with a baby girl and Alan is convinced that he is the father. Meanwhile, Jake is in a contentious mood and Charlie thinks he knows why.

SitcomLegends.us.st: David Copperfield slipped me a Roofie
SitcomLegends.us.d: Convinced that Alan's family doesn't fully appreciate him, Melissa (guest star KELLY STABLES) invites Alan to live with her and her mom (guest star CAROL KANE).

SitcomLegends.us.st: I'd like to start with the cat
SitcomLegends.us.d: Charlie finds himself in couples counseling.

The Butlers and Johnsons are rattled in different ways after an earthquake strikes,with Calvin and Tina moving in with Malcolm and Marty while their home is repaired,and Dave going to extremes trying to prepare his family for the next time.
When there's a break-in at Calvin's business, he teams up with Dave for a stakeout to catch the culprit in the act. Also, Gemma is uncharacteristically reluctant to share her new hobby with Tina.

SitcomLegends.us.st: Welcome to the Big Little Leagues
SitcomLegends.us.d: Calvin and Malcolm butt heads on coaching styles as Malcolm's little league team approaches its first game of the season. Also, Tina tries to win over a food critic she inadvertently offended before he reviews her cupcakes.

After months of crashing with Malcolm and Marty, Calvin and Tina finally reveal the impressive results of their major home renovation.  Also, Dave and Gemma decide it's time to have "the talk" with Grover.

When Calvin discovers his friend, Lorenzo, (Bill Bellamy), is harboring a secret, he struggles with whether to share the info with Tina. Also, Dave becomes concerned about Gemmas growing closeness to a coach at her school.

SitcomLegends.us.st: Welcome to Bro Money, Bro Problems
SitcomLegends.us.d: Calvin's wealthy and impulsive brother Curtis makes a surprise visit, creating chaos in the Butlers' lives. Also, Dave and Gemma run into challenges while trying to declutter their home.

When Dave's job requires him to mediate a feud between two wealthy brothers, Calvin tries to help but winds up complicating the process; Gemma turns to Tina for assistance in navigating Grover's first crush.

Calvin and Tina offer to throw a quinceañera for Yoli (Alycia Pascual-Pena), a teen Calvin is mentoring at his auto shop. Also, Dave and Gemma introduce Malcolm to a college baseball coach who has the potential to change his future.
When Calvin is honored by the Chamber of Commerce for the positive impact his business has had on the community, he hopes to finally gain the approval of his mother, Marilyn.
When Tina reunites with her former girl group after decades apart, old issues are reignited, threatening to derail the trio's big performance.

As Marty prepares to propose to his girlfriend, Calvin and Tina work with party planner Chika (Gina Yashere) to throw a celebration that properly honors their future daughter-in-law's Nigerian heritage.
When Dave decides to disconnect the Johnson home from the grid, he inadvertently causes a community-wide power outage, much to Calvin's frustration on the fifth season premiere.

Now that Deacon and Kelly have separated, Doug makes it his mission to get his friend out of the funk he's been in by taking him out to the clubs.

ClassicMovieWesterns.us.d: This fifth and final collaboration between John Wayne and director Howard Hawks is an action-filled Western set after the Civil War, in which a group of men seek out Union traitors responsible for a string of train robbers.

The cattle rancher McLintock (John Wayne) puts his brand on the territory and every woman in it!  Louise Warren plays a widow who moves with her two children onto McLintock’s ranch to serve as cook, while Maureen O’Hara plays the estranged wife.
Gene Autry goes to the home of hypochondriac landowner, who gets Gene to switch identities while he takes a vacation, giving Gene power-of-attorney. Gene has to raise $50,000 to save the properties.
Gene Autry and the Cass County Boys are unjustly arrested as bank bandits. Released by police as decoys to locate the loot, Gene and the boys find themselves in trouble with the real bank robbers.
Gene Autry is a cattle rancher determined to protect the interests of neighboring ranchers and Indians against unscrupulous land manipulators when local authorities plan to build an aqueduct.

Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.
A group of mismatched young robbers attempts to make it as outlaws on the frontier, but their ill-fated heists quickly reveal just how unprepared they are for life in the Wild West.

ClassicMovieWesterns.us.st: Return To Lonesome Dove: Part I - The Vision
ClassicMovieWesterns.us.d: Back in Texas, Capt. Call organizes a mustang drive to Montana. He hires a Gideon, a former Texas Ranger, to head the drive. Newt falls into trouble in is rescued by a crusty rancher named Dunnegan.

ClassicMovieWesterns.us.st: Return To Lonesome Dove: Part II - The Forge
ClassicMovieWesterns.us.d: Gideon's mustang drive encounters problems. Agostina must fend off the unwanted advances of cowboys. Call makes his way to Clara's ranch, and then moves on to Montana.

ClassicMovieWesterns.us.st: Return To Lonesome Dove: Part III - The Legacy
ClassicMovieWesterns.us.d: Clara's ranch meets an fiery fate, and she decides to join with Gideon. Call has the misfortune to meet up with the desperado Cherokee Jack. Dunnegan tells Newt of his inheritance plans.

ClassicMoviesChannel.us.d: A submarine captain and his supply officer are determined to get their dry-dock sub back into WWII action. However, a bevy of nurses comes aboard, causing hijinks in the hot pink sub.

The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama as a submarine commander (Gable) drives his men and his 1st officer (Lancaster) to the brink of mutiny in his quest to sink an enemy sub. Robert Wise directs.
Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

This Oscar®-nominated film has the legendary Cary Grant as a government attorney who can't seem to shake his bad fortune. Living on a houseboat, widowed and left with three unruly kids, he hires Sophia Loren as a governess.

Two divorced men decide to share a New York apartment. Fussy Felix, fastidious to a fault.  He proves that cleanliness is next to insanity.  And Oscar, who wreaks havoc on a tidy room with the speed and thoroughness of a tornado.
Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine and Fred MacMurray are superb in this tale of love and ambition in the world of big business that went on to garner a Best Picture Oscar.

This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

Intense, enthralling, and unforgettable, Sunset Boulevard stars Gloria Swanson as Norma Desmond, a faded silent-movie star, and William Holden as Joe Gillis, a down-on-his-luck screenwriter whom she enlists to help her make her triumphant return.

FlicksofFury.us.d: Legendary Bruce Lee's only complete directorial film is packed with action and epic fight scenes. Lee visits his relatives at their restaurant in Italy and has to help them defend against brutal gangsters harassing them.
Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.
A young woman is trained from birth to be a deadly instrument of revenge against the swindlers who destroyed her family.

FlicksofFury.us.t: Lady Snowblood 2: Love Song Of Vengeance
FlicksofFury.us.d: To avoid a death sentence for her prior acts of bloodshed, the vengeful swordswoman Lady Snowblood is conscripted by the Japanese Secret Police to assassinate political dissidents.
The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.st: Willie Or Won't He III: This Time It's Personal
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: After years of on-again, off-again dating and a pair of broken engagements, William and Monica finally tie the knot. At the reception, Robert Dooling, one of William’s biggest clients, thanks him for delaying his honeymoon to oversee an important merger.

After Aaron and Joan experience an uncomfortable moment when they run into one of Aaron's ex-girlfriends, they decide to discuss their past relationships with one another to avoid future awkward moments.

After splitting from Eldon over his objection to pre-marital sex, Lynn longs to get back together. She feels they share a special connection, but Eldon doesn’t appreciate Lynn’s attempts to seduce him.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: A Dingo Ate My Dream House
GirlfriendsFilms.us.st: A Dingo Ate My Dream House
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: Tired of all the inconveniences of living in the suburbs, Darnell (Khalil Kain) suggests to Maya (Golden Brooks) they should move back to the city, but Maya disagrees and does not want to give up her new home.

Ever since Monica left William, his life’s been a mess. He can’t work, eat or function normally. Because Joan, Maya, and Lynn feel responsible for driving Monica away, they decide they’ve got to do something to bring the couple back together.
When Lynn's (Persia White) new boyfriend Eldon (Kadeem Hardison), finds himself at odds with the church members over his choice of having Lynn as a girlfriend, he is faced with a tough decision.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: To Be Determined / It's Been Determined
GirlfriendsFilms.us.st: To Be Determined / It's Been Determined
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.
Joan (Tracee Ellis Ross) unexpectedly proposes to Aaron (guest star Richard T. Jones), but when he stumbles on his response, Joan decides the relationship is over and walks away.
When Joan buys an expensive new kitchen range for their new house, her fiance Aaron gets upset that she spent money without discussing it with him.

In order to prevent Aaron from going to Iraq, Joan kidnaps him and takes him to Mexico. In Mexico, Aaron explains to Joan that he cannot run away from the war and suggests they get married before he leaves.

When Lynn meets Xander, a cute student at UCLA, he asks her to perform at a rally raising awareness to save the environment. But when Lynn's manager gets her a gig at the House of Blues for the same day, she must decide where she will perform.
Maya tries to avoid calls from her publisher when she experiences writer's block and is unable to complete her third book.
When Maya accuses Darnell of blaming her for the miscarriage, Joan and Lynn are worried that Maya is in denial and not allowing herself to grieve.
Joan is convinced that Maya is not coping with the recent loss of her baby, and decides a little retail therapy will help her recover.

At a gathering to celebrate William and Monica's pregnancy, Maya makes a joke that the baby is hers. Worried that Maya is having trouble dealing with the loss of their baby, Darnell confronts Maya and learns that she has been taking pills to help her cope
Lynn calls Joan, Maya, and William old after realizing they never go out anymore. They decide to prove Lynn wrong by joining her for a night on the town at a hot new club.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: R-E-S-P-E-C-T, Find Out What It Means to William
GirlfriendsFilms.us.st: R-E-S-P-E-C-T, Find Out What It Means to William
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: When William begins to feel that he is not respected at work he considers leaving the firm, and Monica freaks out thinking that he won’t be able to support her and their new baby.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: Deck the Halls With Bags and Folly
GirlfriendsFilms.us.st: Deck the Halls With Bags and Folly
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: Joan joins a support group for people who have relatives serving in Iraq but is upset when she finds out they are not planning a holiday party due to financial restraints.
Maya and Darnell romanticize the idea of adopting until they attend a neighborhood group for people who have adopted children and are offered a baby girl to adopt.

Joan goes to the school where Aaron used to teach in order to read a letter he sent to his former students. However, when Joan arrives, the students give her a hard time so Maya decides to use her street smarts to help Joan get through to the students.
Lynn gets upset when she learns that her record label is pushing back the release of her album to promote another artist, Chrisette Michele.

Four girlfriends: picky lawyer Joan, gold-digging real estate agent Toni, professional student Lynn, and Joan's headstrong assistant Maya get involved with each other's loves and lives, particularly after Toni starts dating Joan's ex.
Joan, who hasn't had sex in a year, decides to have a one-night stand with handsome restaurateur Davis.

Joan, Toni, and Lynn decide to find dates on the Internet. When Joan meets Marcus she thinks he is too good to be true until she finds out he wears a girdle. Toni breaks it off with her date simply because he's too black.
Joan's new boyfriend Marcus has been moving a bit too fast and she realizes her heart was not in the relationship in the first place.
With Maya and Joan becoming close friends, Toni becomes jealous and feels she's losing her best friend.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: The Importance of Being Frank
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: Joan starts dating her client's very attractive accountant Keith, only to be stalked by his estranged wife.
Joan learns that Maya's husband may be cheating on her and must face whether or not it's a good idea to tell her friend. Toni dates a City Councilman who can help further her career.
Maya and her partner Darnell decide they want to renew their vows and have a formal wedding ceremony. Joan offers to help with the event and to have it at her home.

GirlfriendsFilms.us.t: Girlfriends: The Remains of the Date
GirlfriendsFilms.us.d: Joan is determined to play the ultimate Halloween prank on William and succeeds. Meanwhile, Toni is left to deal with her dates strange sexual fetish for stuffed animals.
On a holiday that emphasizes togetherness, Joan struggles with feelings of loneliness and separation on Thanksgiving.

Baby has never been in Joan's vocabulary until she gets the scare of her life and a new perspective on her priorities. As a result, the girls come together to give their love and support, showing their true Girlfriend friendship.
Dreading another dateless weekend, the girls and William try Maya's suggestion to make a list of what they want in a mate.
Joan's new boyfriend Sean has not made a move on her after three weeks of dating and she is beginning to wonder why.
Joan begins to question her relationship with Sean when he gives her a power drill for Valentine's and doesn't hear from him for three days.
Joan decides it is time to give in on her three-month rule and she is finally going to have sex with her boyfriend Sean.
Joan and Toni decide that Lynn needs to learn to be independent. They give her a week to find a job, then she is on her own.
Joan discovers that being the only black woman at her firm has many disadvantages and she is constantly ignored and overlooked.
Maya checks into the hospital for her fibroid surgery and Joan has trouble managing her time between her boyfriend and her friends.

MerryChristmasfromViafree.se.d: Da to svindlere mødes efter at have crashet den samme millionærs julefrokost, bliver de enige om at samarbejde – uvidende om, at de snart finder noget, der er vigtigere end rigdom og berømmelse: ægte kærlighed.
En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.
Charlotte ender i koma efter en ulykke, men hendes sjæl er vågen. Inden en afstemning om et ejendomsprojekt skal hun få sin by og bygherren til at skifte mening, mens ingen kan se eller høre hende.
Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.
Maggie fejrer jul med sin bror Paul og hans datter, efter at hans kone døde for nylig. Det får hende til at indse, hvad der mangler i hendes liv.
To rivaliserende ejendomsmæglere er tvunget til at arbejde sammen for at sælge et særligt hus, der ejes af en kendt botaniker og misteltenavler, lige op til jul.
Megan har fundet sit drømmejob i en madvirksomhed, men først må hun lære at bage. Da hun rekrutterer en flot bager til at hjælpe sig, ender hun uforvarende med at deltage i en julebagekonkurrence.
Mens hoteldirektør Georgia navigerer i romantiske forviklinger med kokken og en flot prins, får vi et glimt af de andre gæsters og personalets liv på Hotel Maison i New York.

En kvinde rejser et år tilbage i tiden. Tilbage til julen før hendes forlovelse gik i stykker, hvor hun vil forsøge at reparere, det der gik galt. Hun opdager at det er måske en større opgave end hun troede.
Sara foretrækker at sidde på sidelinjen på arbejdet, men da hendes juleidé bliver stjålet, ønsker hun, at hun endelig får mod til at stå op for sig selv. Kan julemanden opfylde hendes ønske?

NonStopKungFu.se.d: Donatello, Rafael, Michelangelo og Leonardo er muterede grønne ninja-skildpadder som elsker pizza og lever under New York. Derfra tager de kampen op mod den ondskabsfulde forbryder Shredder og hans hær af sortklædte krigere.

Fem venner bliver løsladt fra fængslet. De har bestemt sig for at leve hæderlige liv fremover, og sammen starter de et rengøringsfirma. Men samme dag løslades også en sjette fange og hans planer er at tjene penge på falskmøntneri.

Et magisk scepter transporterer deres gode ven April gennem tid og sted, helt til samuraiernes Japan. Leonardo og de andre tager straks af sted efter hende og skal nu besejre den onde Lord Naringa for at redde den indespærrede April.

NonStopKungFu.se.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
NonStopKungFu.se.d: Skildpadderne tror, at deres fjende Shredder døde, da han faldt i affaldsknuseren i slutningen af den foregående film. Fodklanen har opdaget på deres skjulested i kloakkerne, og derfor padderne hos journalisten April.

Unge Lung viser talent, men tager ikke sin træning alvorligt. Hans farfar og tillige shaolinmester, forsøger at lære ham både disciplin og kampsport, men han går mest op i det sidstnævnte. I stedet for at fokusere på træningen bruger han sin tid på barer.
Jackie Chans eventyrer er tilbage i en ny jagt på en glemt skat, skjult i ørkenen af nazisterne inden 2. Verdenskrig. Men Jackie og hans makker Ada er ikke de eneste, der leder efter skatten...

Hongkong-betjenten Muscle tager til Japan i jagten på en korrupt kollega. Men da yakuzaen allerede har hans oplysninger, kan han ikke udføre jobbet alene. Muscle tilklader derfor sine gamle venner fra børnehjemmet til at hjælpe ham.

NonStopKungFu.se.t: Half a Loaf of Kung Fu
NonStopKungFu.se.d: Jackie Chan spiller Jiang, som voksede op uden forældre. Selv om han hverken har et akademisk hoved eller de kampsportsfærdigheder, han gerne ville have, så lykkes det ham snyde sig til steder og berømmelse, som han kun har kunnet drømme om.

En ung mand sætter sig for at hævne sin bedstefars død og bevise sit mesterskab i kampsport. Denne film vises uden undertekster.

Steve warns Dilys of the theft risk, but she scorns him. In Hawaii for vacation, Steve suspects Dilys brought a valuable ruby and tries to protect her, but faces resistance. Can he save her from theft?
Paul Williams as Stringer snaps a picture of a secret meeting of racketeer Alika and influence peddler Kramer. Paul uses this evidence to extort Kramer, putting himself in danger from Alika.

Steve McGarrett chases after ex-cop, now private detective, Russ Hendrix, whom he admires but suspects of killing Honolulu pimps. Hendrix knows McGarrett is onto him, making the pursuit dangerous. Will McGarrett bring the murderer to justice?
Steve suspects Dr. Danworth of illegally supplying drugs to addicts and must build a case while protecting him from a vengeful father. Addict's overdose prompts investigation.
Steve hunts down the Skyline Killer but is hindered by writer Norman Klane who wants to sell the killer's story for big bucks and divide the fortune with the murderer.

Steve McGarrett investigates the death of a young Asian girl on a flight from Bangkok to Honolulu. The girl was a heroin courier for a drug ring in Singapore. McGarrett sets out to dismantle the operation and uncover the truth behind the girl's death.
Gibbs and the team work to clear the name of a Navy medic killed in Iraq, who is the prime suspect in a murder in his hometown.  (TV-PG)
When a letter sealed with a kiss is delivered to NCIS, Tony assumes it's for him and opens it, only to release a mysterious powder into the squad room.  (TV-PG)
Gibbs' worst fears are confirmed when he learns that his nemesis, Arab/Israeli double agent Ari (Rudolf Martin), is back in Washington D.C. on assignment to kill him. (TV-PG)
While the NCIS team deals with Kate's death, Gibbs' determination to finally put an end to Ari's (guest star Rudolf Martin) reign of terror mounts.
Ari (guest start Rudolf Martin) continues to wreak havoc on the NCIS team as he uses its members as pawns in the game he is playing with Gibbs.

Under order from the Governor of Virginia, a skeptical Gibbs is forced to meet with a serial killer he helped to convict a decade before under the pretense that the killer will tell Gibbs where he hid missing bodies.
A man Melanie intended to break up with dies, Joy dodges calls from her mother, Victoria tries an ab-toning belt, and Elka and Mamie Sue write roast jokes for a centenarian.
Victoria contacts all her exes to find out what she could have done differently, unexpectedly seeing in-person Julian, the one who broke her heart.
The women's group birthday includes a professor as well as a reunion of Elka and Mamie Sue's bowling team.
At Victoria's bare-bones wedding to Emmet in prison, the officiating tabloid photographer turns out to be Simon, the man who got Joy pregnant as a teenager.
After Alex Trebek introduces the episode, the women are held hostage by Chester, Lily, and a Mrs. Ladypants-loving plastic surgeon.
Following Emmet's escape from prison, Victoria is under close watch by an FBI agent, and Alec's new girlfriend questions Melanie's pregnancy.
As Joy, Owen and Simon lie about their family history to get Wilbur admitted into a prestigious preschool, Elka helps Melanie find a doctor to treat her brain tumor.
Discovering that Emmet faked his own death, Victoria decides to follow suit to be with him, as Simon rethinks his career, and Melanie dates a guy who doesn't spoon correctly.

The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room.  Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey.  Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic.  Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
PlutoTVFantasyHorror.de.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

Classica.us.t: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert

Classica.us.t: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky

Classica.us.t: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
